player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Craft room and the Exercise room, repeatedly going south and then north. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue exploring the same rooms instead of recognizing that I had already visited them. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have already visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also try to explore new rooms by taking a new, untried direction from the current room. If I notice that I'm repeating moves, I will take a new direction instead of going back to a previously visited room.
